constraints: preserve incident, fingerprint, boundary, schedule, and shared transition
never retry integrity, unsupported, ownership_lost, or configuration

executor_ownership.boring-cdc-m2-capture-runtime: persist-before-close, EOF/advisory races, retained-WAL/config re-arm, no reconnect
executor_ownership.boring-cdc-m2-jsonl: archive real adapter and unchanged corpus
executor_ownership.boring-cdc-m4-durability: ClickHouse real adapter and unchanged corpus
executor_ownership.boring-cdc-m5-loops: independent destination schedulers/adapters and unchanged corpus

expected_close.advisory_race: mismatched advisory session is ownership_lost despite matching run/generation
expected_close.matched: persist intent before close; matching delayed EOF is capture_safe_stopped, not CopyBoth loss
expected_close.persistence_failure: close unauthorized; no token and no reconnect
expected_close.reconnect: never in-process; only downstream ownership/capture-runtime may restart or re-arm
expected_close.unmatched: missing or mismatched run/generation is ownership_lost

failed_boundary.identity: RFC 8785 JCS bytes of the complete tagged variant

fingerprint.different_fingerprint: create a new UUIDv7 incident; never mutate or re-arm the old incident
fingerprint.same_fingerprint: update active record in place; deterministic classes stay suppressed and transient attempts do not reset

persisted_record.optionals: every optional field is present as explicit null

purpose: One closed persisted failure policy for capture, ClickHouse, and archive; no runtime behavior is implemented here.

rearm.matching: incident_id, fingerprint, and complete boundary equal persisted incident

recovery_predicates.configuration: relevant config fingerprint changed and validated; unrelated changes forbidden
recovery_predicates.integrity: completed reseed to new capture epoch

results.forbidden: unsupported, failed recovery, cross-epoch, or weakened integrity/continuity
results.rearmed: fresh matching token and class recovery succeeds

restart_and_clock.clock_movement: effective remaining delay is max(persisted monotonic_remaining_ms, max(0,next_retry_utc-now_utc)); wall-clock changes never shorten delay
restart_and_clock.restart: reload persisted attempt and schedule; process restart never resets either
restart_and_clock.supervisor_restarts: unlimited restarts do not bypass maximum_attempts or schedule

safety_invariants: no checkpoint or source feedback skip
no attempt reset on process restart
ownership loss requires new generation and ownership proof
capture and unaffected destination remain independent subject to retention/pressure

schedule.attempt_semantics: attempt is the persisted count of failed executions for this incident; failures producing attempts 1 through 9 schedule retry; failure producing attempt 10 transitions to requires_operator

test_randomness.sample: first 8 block bytes as little-endian u64

rules: persist attempt and jittered schedule before retry
capture safe-stops; destination degrades; clear schedule
timer before deadline or process restart
consume nonce; clear schedule; retain audit
